aspects.says: On a LinkedHashSet or LinkedHashMap, addFirst/addLast and putFirst/putLast move an existing entry, while add and put leave it where it was.
basis: section:On LinkedHashSet and LinkedHashMap, addFirst and putLast Move an Existing Entry

aspects.says: Math.clamp(long, int, int) narrows a long without wrapping, where casting first wraps; clamp throws when min > max and returns NaN for a NaN value.
basis: section:Math.clamp Narrows a long Without Wrapping and Refuses a Reversed Range

aspects.says: A class compiled for 17 with a clashing method still runs on a 21 JVM, because the JVM links by name and descriptor; a matching method silently overrides the new default.
basis: section:A Class That Already Had These Names Runs on 21 but No Longer Compiles for It

aspects.says: A class whose own getFirst/getLast/reversed has an incompatible return type or weaker access, or that is both a List and a Deque, stops compiling for --release 21.
basis: section:A Class That Already Had These Names Runs on 21 but No Longer Compiles for It

aspects.says: Character.isEmoji and its siblings take code points, so chars() misses emoji outside the BMP; isEmoji is true for digits, '#' and '*', where isExtendedPictographic is not; StringBuilder.repeat(int, int) takes a code point.
basis: section:isEmoji and StringBuilder.repeat Have Code-Point Overloads, and isEmoji Says Yes to Digits

aspects.says: getFirst() and getLast() throw NoSuchElementException on an empty collection, while firstEntry() on an empty map returns null, so code moved from get(0) changes its exception.
basis: section:Ordered Collections Now Share getFirst, getLast and reversed(); Unordered Ones Don't Get Them

aspects.says: String.indexOf(ch, begin, end) throws for a range outside the string, including end = -1, and returns an index counted from the start of the string.
basis: section:The Range Form of indexOf Throws Where the Old Form Returned -1

aspects.says: Only collections with a defined order are sequenced (not HashSet or HashMap); sorted sets and unmodifiable lists refuse addFirst and addLast.
basis: section:Ordered Collections Now Share getFirst, getLast and reversed(); Unordered Ones Don't Get Them

aspects.says: reversed() returns a view: writes through it change the original, later changes to the original show in it, and a snapshot or a read-only view needs a copy or a wrapper.
basis: section:reversed() Is a View: Writes Go Through, and Later Changes Show Through
